name: Four-Cycle Relative Gluing Model
definition: Split the consistently directed four-cycle into its two length-two directed paths. Their oriented bipartite-graph classes are 31-concept pieces with the same 22-concept endpoint section $D$; embed them with disjoint private middle coordinates and glue along $D$.
properties: The union has 40 concepts. Protected two-row reductions give four selections per piece, 16 candidate selection pairs, 14 actual nerve vertices, and gluing-nerve $f$-vector $(14,48,48,12)$ with $\mathbb F_2$ Betti vector $(1,0,1,0)$, hence the expected $S^2$ homology. The exact coefficient-space theorem identifies the union with the strict pullback times one open interval.
